reuse.why: setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the average actions get the flag through the existing getMonthWideCategories/setAllCategoriesAvg helpers, and a shared MonthWideArgs type replaces the repeated argument types; copyPreviousMonth still keeps its own hidden check.

duplication.why: The include-hidden decision is written twice: as an interpolated SQL clause in getMonthWideCategories and as an inline `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)` check in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared selection helper for most actions; copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding hidden-ness locally, as it did before.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, a shared args type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change with one helper owning most of the rule, but the hidden rule lives in two forms (SQL string building vs JS condition) that have to be kept in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts applies the hidden/include-hidden rule inline instead of going through getMonthWideCategories (pre-existing bypass, extended by the diff).

disguised_duplication.where: The include-hidden rule appears as a conditional SQL fragment in getMonthWideCategories and, reshaped as a JS boolean, in copyPreviousMonth.
